title: Aquemi products: P-40, P-80, dosing tank and AeroWell | Aquemi
meta: Standard Aquemi equipment with a fixed datasheet: the P-40 portable pure-water cart, the P-80, a dosing tank and the AeroWell atmospheric water generator.
headline: Standard equipment, one datasheet each
lead: EMI is engineered to your requirements. Products are standard items: one design, one datasheet, built to order. Four today: the P-40 portable pure-water cart, the P-80, a dosing tank and the AeroWell atmospheric water generator.

blocks.intro: Each product is one fixed design with its own datasheet. The first units of each are built to order, with a longer lead time while we complete the design.

items.d: Hose in, hose out, no power. Sediment, carbon, one 4040 RO element and mixed-bed DI on a wheeled frame, for rinse, fill and top-up water.
[P-80: what it is, in one line]. In design; datasheet to follow.
[Dosing tank: what it is, in one line]. In design; datasheet to follow.
Drinking water from the air: 9 US gal (34 L) a day at 26 °C and 60 % humidity, on a 120 V outlet.

blocks.intro: Both come from the same shop. What differs is who sets the design.
rows: Your user requirement specification (URS) and feed water
Purified Water, designed to meet USP <645> and <643>
Low-mineral or drinking water; not a pharmacopoeial grade
Design, fabrication, test and qualification records
Factory acceptance test with water, witnessed; IQ, OQ and PQ

items.q: Can a product make Purified Water for a GMP plant?
items.a: No. Products are not designed or certified for pharmaceutical, dialysis or laboratory water grades. That is EMI's job.
Trades, light industry, mobile and off-grid users: rinse, fill, top-up and drinking water where no plant exists.

Send the enquiry form with the product name. We confirm price, lead time and freight in writing. The first units of each product are built to order, with a longer lead time while we complete the design.
